Name: MENUPROPERTY_SPEC
Description: Determines the data sources for various menu elements.

Fields.Name: Caption Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text shown as the property's label. 0 or less: no label. A layout row's own Caption Text ID overrides it.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown beside the property. -1: no icon.

Fields.Name: Requirement Property ID
Fields.Description: The required proprerty ID for this element.

Fields.Name: Compare Type
Fields.Description: How the value is judged when two items are compared. 1: higher is better. 2: lower is better. 0: not compared.

Fields.Name: Format Type
Fields.Description: How the value is written. Otherwise: 0 plain number; 1 whole number with + when 0 or more; 2 plain number, "-" when 0 or less; 3 (1 − value) × 100 as a whole number; 4 value × 1000, rounded; 10/11/12 1/2/3 decimals; 20/21/22 (1 − value) × 100 with 1/2/3 decimals; 100 scaling letter (S from 141, A 101, B 81, C 51, D 21, E 1, else "-"); any other value plain number.
